Abram had heard, to wit, that his brother Lot was taken, he num-
bred of the ſeruants borne in his houſe, wel appointed, thrre hundred
and eighteen: and purſued them vnto Dau 1†. And diuiding hic
companie, he ranne vpon them in the night, and ſtruck them,
and purſued them vnto Hoba, which is on the lett hand of Pa-
maſcus. 16. And he brought backe al the ſubſtance, and Lot his
brothet with his ſubſtance, the women alſo and the people. 17.
And the Ring of Sodom went forth to meet them atter he te-
turned trom the ſlaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the Ringe
that were with him in the vale Sauee, whtch is the kings vale.
18. But Melchiſedech the Ring of Salem , ‖ bringing forth bread
and wine, for he was the Prieſt of God moſt High, 19. blefſed
him, and ſaid: Bleſſed be Abram to God the Higheſt, which
created heauen and earth: 20. and bleſſed be God the Higheſt
by whoſe protection the enemyes are in thy hands. And he gaue
him the tyths of al. 21. And the Ring of Sodom faid to Abtatn:
Giue me the ſoules, and the reſt take to thee. 22. Who anſweted
him : I lift vp my hand to my Lord God moſt High, poſſeſſour ot
heauen and earth, 23. that from the vety woote- thread vnto the ſhoe
latchet, I wil not take ot al that are thine, (a) leſt thou ſay, I haue (2) Abraham
enriched Abram : 24. except ſuch things as the yong men haue eaten
and the ihares of the men that came with me, Aner, Eſchol, and
Mambre: theſe ſhal take theit ihares.
